name: code-review-and-quality
tagline_zh: 合并前总心慌？让 Agent 从架构、安全、性能多轴挑刺，连你忽略的边界条件都揪出来，像资深同事坐你旁边。
tagline_en: Nervous before merge? This skill audits code across architecture, security, and performance—catching edge cases.
desc_en: Conducts multi-axis code review. Use before merging any change. Use when reviewing code written by yourself, another agent, or a human. Use when you need to assess code quality across multiple dimensions before it enters the main branch.
why_zh: 不是泛泛检查，而是按多轴维度逐项打分，给出具体修改建议，比普通 lint 或自检多一层架构视角。
why_en: Not generic linting—it scores across axes and suggests concrete fixes, adding an architecture layer your usual checks miss.
